purpose: C3 v2.1 operational tuning contract: preserve the immutable v2.0 ALFRED first-release evidence while applying registered causal analysis transforms and detector policies.

cohort_design.dependence_policy: Event anchors within the same NBER cycle are dependent. Report event-anchor, event-series-pair and episode-cluster coverage separately. Do not treat 37 pairs as 37 independent shocks or use naive iid confidence intervals across them.
cohort_design.calibration_unit: One independent equal-risk calibration per unique series across its full registered monitoring horizon.
cohort_design.cohort_change_policy: No event, anchor, direction, window or series may be added or removed after source intake begins without a new contract version and explicit provenance.

guardrails.first_release_definition: Earliest ALFRED vintage date at which an observation is non-missing.
guardrails.ar_selection: minimum AIC; unstable winning order fails closed; do not fall back to a higher-AIC order

matching_contract.window_bounds: inclusive calendar-exact ±12 months around each event anchor, using available_at
matching_contract.direction_rule: Only alerts matching the event's pre-registered expected_sign are eligible.
matching_contract.one_to_one_rule: Within each series and detector, candidate alert-event matches are ordered by absolute calendar distance, then available_at, event_id and detection index. Greedy assignment uses each alert and each event at most once.
matching_contract.overlapping_windows: An alert cannot be reused across overlapping windows; unmatched alerts are counted once, not once per event.
matching_contract.early_warning_policy: A correctly directed alert inside the pre-registered window before the anchor is a match and carries a negative detection lag.
matching_contract.episode_reporting: Aggregate event-level matches to episode_id. A cluster counts as detected if one or more of its registered anchors are matched; do not claim independent evidence for multiple anchors in one cluster.

series.series_note: 40-observation null-model fitting prefix ends before the first registered NBER peak in December 1969.

C3 v2.1 converts first-release payroll employment levels to causal first differences. The July 1966 predecessor is extracted from the already archived raw ALFRED vintage CSVs so the transformed 40-point prefix ends before the December 1969 first registered anchor.
series.analysis_units: Monthly change in thousands of persons, seasonally adjusted
series.predecessor_source: Existing first-release raw ALFRED vintage batches inside source artifact; no archive mutation or new ALFRED acquisition.

series.units: Dollars per barrel, not seasonally adjusted
series.series_note: 40-week fitting prefix precedes the June 2014 oil-decline anchor. No pre-archive first-release values are backfilled.
40-week fitting prefix predates the March 2020 COVID unemployment shock anchor.

engine_optimization.objective: Operational detector quality: detect real changes, control repeated alarms in quiet periods, detect both directions, recover after alerts, and generalize across cadence and series type.
engine_optimization.policy: Use the existing C3 v2.0 ALFRED source archive as immutable input; apply causal transforms in memory; use monthly 10-point and weekly 20-point FOCuS re-arm windows; use an eight-observation Hybrid confirmation window; exclude members that failed Holdout from Hybrid.
